description: What changes between two releases of a package, from registry metadata: dependencies added, removed and re-ranged, licence change, deprecation, publish dates and the releases in between, and which OSV advisories the upgrade fixes, introduces or leaves open. Registry metadata only: a source-code diff is not claimed. Price: 0.008 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"deps_compare_releases"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/deps/compare?ecosystem=npm&name=lodash&from=4.17.15&to=4.17.21
name: deps_compare_releases
title: YRUZ DependencyPulse Release Compare (0.008 USDC)
